baseline_models.focus_anchor: The doubled ث ب ت at focus words 1 and 6, joined through بِٱلْقَوْلِ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The causative act strengthens believers through a saying whose own defining property is resistance to removal. The repeated root links divine action, supporting medium, and durable result across both life-horizons.

activation_trace.role: Making a thing stable and strengthening heart or foot supplies the active support exerted on the believers.
Duration and resistance to disappearance supply the resulting continuity named again by الثابت.
An uttered saying supplies the explicit medium through which the stabilizing act operates.
The production of an act keeps stabilization and misguidance as enacted outcomes rather than static labels.

changed_reading.before: God keeps believers firm by a firm statement in both lives.
changed_reading.after: God actively builds a reinforcing relation in which a durable saying supports durable persons, and that support remains operative across both temporal domains.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثبات القلب والعقل واللسان, together with القول and those who آمنوا.
baseline_models.mechanism: The fixed saying can join inward trust, unvoiced conviction, and outward utterance. Stabilization then preserves congruence among heart, judgment, and tongue, especially where speech is contested.

activation_trace.role: Stability of heart, intellect, and tongue supplies the three registers that the saying holds together.
A saying conceived within the self supplies the inward register before verbal disclosure.
Speech brought out in articulation supplies the public register corresponding to inward conviction.
Quiet confidence and trust in the heart supply the secure interior from which stable speech can issue.
Heart-settling assent supplies the propositional commitment carried by the saying.

changed_reading.before: Believers are enabled to repeat a correct formula.
changed_reading.after: Believers are held in an integrated witness whose inward assent, judgment, and outward tongue do not split under pressure.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: الثبت والحجة والإثبات in ث ب ت, القول as belief or indication, and the paired يُضِلُّ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ.
baseline_models.mechanism: The focus can stage an epistemic or forensic establishment: a proposition is fixed as proof before sight or insight, while those who put things out of place lose the object or its location. This coexists with the affective reading of firmness.

activation_trace.role: Proof, establishment by judgment or word, and fixation before sight or insight supply the evidentiary mechanism.
A saying as held belief supplies the proposition that can be established rather than merely sounded.
A thing's saying as its indication supplies the link between proposition and what it evidences.
Putting a thing in the wrong sensible place supplies the wrongdoers' dislocation of the relevant relation.
Loss of a thing or failure to find its location supplies the counter-outcome to evidentiary fixation.

changed_reading.before: The verse contrasts psychologically firm believers with morally erring wrongdoers.
changed_reading.after: It can also contrast a claim made evidentially standing with a displaced relation that becomes unlocatable, without reducing firmness to mood.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediately preceding sequence gives the saying a living architecture: a good word is a tree, its root is fixed, its branch rises, and its yield recurs; the bad counterpart is wholly uprooted and has no settlement. The focus therefore reads as God's cultivation of persons through a rooted, productive word, while misguidance becomes loss of anchorage.

activation_trace.role: A saying as a thing's indication lets the focus word carry the preceding tree-sign without becoming identical to literal timber.
Active strengthening supplies the cultivation that transfers the tree's rooted stability to believers.
A meaningful word or expression supplies the verbal entity explicitly compared to the tree.
A stemmed tree supplies the organism whose parts make stability spatial and productive.
The base or root supplies the hidden anchoring layer of the good word.
Persistence against removal explicitly qualifies the tree's root and hands the same image into the focus ayah.
A high branch emerging from an origin supplies visible extension without severance from the stable base.
The yield of tree or crop supplies recurring useful output rather than inert rootedness.
Whole removal from the root supplies the destructive inverse of divine stabilization.
Stability and settlement, here denied, supply the terminal condition lacking from the bad word.

structural_cues: 14:24-27 runs in one sequence from good word and fixed root, through recurrent yield, to uprooted bad word without settlement, then to stabilization by the fixed saying.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies the word-tree, fixed root, yield, uprooting, and absent settlement. I infer that بِٱلْقَوْلِ transfers this plant mechanism to the stabilization of persons; a live alternative is that the simile and the focus merely share vocabulary without a causal transfer.

changed_reading.before: The stable saying is a static proposition used to steady believers.
changed_reading.after: The saying is a rooted living support whose stability generates repeated benefit, and God stabilizes believers by maintaining their participation in that productive architecture.

context_deltas.mechanism: The surah contrasts God's promise of truth with a rival promise that fails, then later denies that God will fail His promise. The fixed saying can therefore be a speech-act whose stability is proven by deferred fulfillment across the near and later lives, not only a sentence with unchanging content.

activation_trace.role: An articulated saying supplies the larger speech category within which a promise can function.
Establishment by word and proof supplies the criterion by which fulfillment makes the saying stand.
A spoken promise that opens expectation supplies two formally similar speech-acts whose reliability diverges.
Truth fixed in correspondence with reality supplies the quality attached to God's promise.
A promise that misses its appointed fulfillment supplies the unstable counterexample confessed by the rival speaker.
The same failure-of-promise branch, explicitly negated of God, supplies retrospective confirmation of reliability.
The returning promise supplies continuity between earlier speech and later realization.

structural_cues: 14:22 places truthful and failed promises side by side; 14:47 returns to non-failure after the focus ayah.
The focus's paired life-horizons provide the interval across which fulfillment can be delayed without becoming breach.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies contrasting promises, truth, failure, and later non-failure. I infer that promise is a salient species of القول and that fulfillment is the arrow from الثابت to cross-life reliability; a live alternative is that القول remains broader than any promissory speech-act.

changed_reading.before: The fixed saying is stable because its wording or doctrine does not change.
changed_reading.after: The saying is stable because the speaker's commitment survives deferral and arrives in reality; believers are steadied by reliance on fulfilled speech rather than by verbal immobility alone.

context_deltas.mechanism: An earlier ayah pairs the near life with the later life but describes preference for the near, obstruction of the path, pursuit of crookedness, and far misguidance. When the focus repeats both life-horizons and misguidance, stabilization becomes maintained orientation across unequal temporal distances: the fixed saying keeps the route coherent when the near horizon exerts pull.

activation_trace.role: Firm feet and persistence supply trajectory-preserving stability across the two named lives.
The near or lower life supplies the proximate horizon that is preferred in the earlier counter-pattern.
What comes after the first supplies the deferred horizon displaced by that preference.
Turning away and turning others aside supplies active blockage of orientation.
An extended traversable path supplies the spatial course on which firmness or deviation matters.
Deviation of meaning from straightness supplies deliberate distortion of the route's intelligibility.
Departure from guidance and intended course supplies the direct inverse of maintained orientation.
Distance from nearness supplies the enlarged separation produced by the crooked course.

structural_cues: 14:3 and 14:27 repeat the near-life/later-life pair but reverse the governing relation: preference and crooked obstruction there, divine stabilization here.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies temporal preference, path blockage, crookedness, and distant deviation. I infer an arrow from distorted horizon-weighting to loss of orientation, with the fixed saying acting as a course invariant; a live alternative is that the two lives are only locations of firmness, not components of a route.

changed_reading.before: Believers receive the same firmness in two separate places or times.
changed_reading.after: Believers are kept on one coherent trajectory through both horizons, while wrongdoers' overinvestment in the nearer horizon bends and lengthens their departure.

context_deltas.mechanism: The ash simile supplies a material countermodel: works become particulate, a forceful wind disperses them, and their owners cannot retain control over any of them. Against that scene, تثبيت can mean giving a saying and its bearer cohesion under dispersive load; ضلال can include actual loss, not only wrong direction.

activation_trace.role: Strengthening a thing supplies the counterforce that keeps a person-word relation from disintegrating.
Ash left by burning supplies the loose material whose parts no longer hold a productive form.
Moving air and wind supply the carrier that removes the unbound material.
A violent wind that makes light things fly supplies the dispersive load applied to the ash.
Capacity that reaches action or possession, syntactically denied here, supplies the failed ability to retain the result.
Loss of a thing or inability to locate it names the condition produced after dispersal.

structural_cues: 14:18 pairs dispersed works with inability and far loss; 14:26 later pairs uprooting with absence of settlement before the focus names stabilization.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies ash, forceful wind, failed capacity, and loss. I infer that these form a material countermodel to ث ب ت and transfer cohesion to the saying-person relation; a live alternative is that the ash image concerns works alone and should not modify القول.

changed_reading.before: Firmness is a posture of conviction.
changed_reading.after: Firmness is also retention: God gives the saying-person complex enough cohesion that its meaningful work is not scattered beyond recovery.

context_deltas.mechanism: Threatened expulsion is answered by settlement in land, then by prayers for a secure city and for descendants settled by the house to establish worship. Since ث ب ت includes residence and firm footing, stabilization in the near life can be social and intergenerational: a stable saying makes durable habitation and practice possible under displacement pressure.

activation_trace.role: Residence in a place and firmness of feet supply the focus anchor for durable habitation.
Passage to the outside supplies the coercive displacement threatened against the messengers.
Making a dwelling one's settled home supplies the direct reversal of expulsion.
A bounded place in the earth supplies the civic scale of requested stability.
Security against fear supplies the condition that lets the city function as a stable dwelling.
Filiation and what is traced to an origin supply the intergenerational line meant to remain anchored.
Settling descendants in a dwelling supplies concrete emplacement in an otherwise barren setting.
Shelter and dwelling supply the focal structure around which the community is placed.
Rising with resolve to an undertaking supplies the recurrent practice that turns location into sustained communal life.

structural_cues: 14:13-14 forms an expulsion/settlement reversal; 14:35-37 repeats security, descendants, dwelling, and established practice after the focus.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies displacement, promised settlement, secure city, lineage, house, and recurrent practice. I infer that the fixed saying is an organizing condition for durable social emplacement; a live alternative is that these are independent geographic promises and prayers with no semantic role for القول.

changed_reading.before: God stabilizes isolated believers inwardly during worldly life.
changed_reading.after: God's stabilization can also preserve a believing line's capacity to inhabit, transmit, and practice through displacement, making the fixed saying a social support rather than only a private conviction.

context_deltas.mechanism: Later paired contrasts of secret/public and concealment/disclosure activate the focus inventory's inner saying and uttered saying. Stability can therefore be integrity across visibility regimes: divine knowledge and support prevent the inward commitment and outward witness from becoming two incompatible sayings.

activation_trace.role: Stability of heart, intellect, and tongue supplies the internal-to-public alignment being preserved.
Speech present in the self but not disclosed supplies the concealed register.
Speech brought out through articulation supplies the manifest register.
Hiding something inwardly supplies one explicitly named mode in which faithful action occurs.
Manifesting something openly supplies the paired public mode.
Concealment and hiddenness supply the epistemic boundary that divine knowledge crosses.
Open disclosure supplies the visible counterpart explicitly paired with concealment.

structural_cues: 14:31 pairs secret and public practice; 14:38 pairs what is concealed and disclosed while denying that anything is hidden from God.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies paired hidden and manifest modes, but those verses concern action and knowledge rather than speech alone. I infer that the focus branches extend the pair to inner and uttered saying; a live alternative is that no integrity claim beyond divine omniscience is intended.

changed_reading.before: The stable saying is chiefly a public confession.
changed_reading.after: The stable saying is an integrity relation: what settles in the heart, what judgment holds, and what the tongue exposes remain mutually answerable in both hidden and public life.

context_deltas.mechanism: The whole-surah sequence moves through a book that can fix an obligating judgment, demanded decisive proof, public emergence, recompense, and accounting. These cues strengthen the baseline forensic reading: the fixed saying is a proposition or witness made to stand through exposure and reckoning, where claim, act, and consequence are brought into correspondence.

activation_trace.role: Proof and establishment by judgment or word supply the focus's forensic anchor.
A saying as held belief supplies a claim capable of being tested through the sequence.
Withholding or blocking a right supplies the wrong whose relation must be exposed and answered.
Written fixation that imposes judgment or decree supplies an authoritative record at the surah's opening.
A compelling proof supplies the evidentiary demand voiced in the dispute.
Emergence into the open supplies the public exposure under which claims can no longer remain sheltered.
Answering an act with its due consequence supplies adjudicated correspondence between deed and result.
Counting and accounting supply the final audit in which established or displaced relations are resolved.

structural_cues: The packet orders book at 14:1, demanded proof at 14:10, universal exposure at 14:21, and recompense/accounting at 14:51 around the focus's establishment vocabulary.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies record, proof, exposure, recompense, and account. I infer a forensic pipeline and assign the fixed saying the role of standing witness within it; a live alternative is that these are distinct rhetorical scenes rather than one adjudicative mechanism.

changed_reading.before: The fixed saying gives believers subjective certainty.
changed_reading.after: It can also be an objectively standing witness whose relation to belief and action survives public exposure and final accounting.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses the packet's non-dominant split mapping ق و ل -> ق ل ل and its agitation branch, not the ordinary lexical sense of قول. It remains anchored to focus word 5 and becomes mechanistically relevant because الثابت and divine causation oppose that branch's lack of settled location, while the failed promise supplies a packet-local instance of unstable speech. Downstream prose should present it only as a form-distant pressure test: stability is achieved against speech's mobility, not as a translation of القول.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The collision between القول at word 5 through mapped root_001251 B006 and the doubled ث ب ت.

activation_trace.role: Agitation, movement, and lack of stability in place supply a latent instability inside the packet's split-root inventory for the saying.
Making stable and strengthening supply the active arrest of that oscillation rather than assuming a naturally motionless medium.
The pair of expectation-opening promises supplies speech that can travel forward toward fulfillment.
Failure to meet the promised appointment supplies one realized form of speech losing its fixed relation to outcome.

changed_reading.before: The saying is intrinsically stable and simply passes its stability to believers.
changed_reading.after: The modifier الثابت and God's causative act may mark a stabilization achieved against the saying-medium's capacity to oscillate, circulate, or detach from fulfillment.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because ث ب ت B007 is the highly specific image of a locust setting its tail to lay eggs. It remains anchored in the focus root and is activated by the adjacent root-tree-yield sequence plus later dissemination of descendants and fruits. Downstream prose should qualify it as a reproductive material analogy for implanted continuity, never as the lexical meaning of يُثَبِّتُ in the ayah.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: ث ب ت at focus words 1 and 6, especially the packet's oviposition branch B007.

activation_trace.role: A locust setting its tail to deposit eggs supplies the odd image of stability as generative emplacement.
A root or base supplies the receptive site in which durable growth is anchored.
The stemmed tree supplies the organism that develops from emplacement into structured life.
Recurring yield of tree or crop supplies the mature output of what was rooted.
Smallness and spreading supply a packet-local reproductive pattern attached to descendants.
Ripe fruit supplies the later generative provision sought for the settled descendants.

changed_reading.before: Stabilization prevents an already formed believer or statement from moving.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, stabilization implants a generative beginning whose rooted continuity can propagate persons, practice, and fruit beyond the initial act.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it reads stability through flowing rivers, moving ships, and unceasing celestial work rather than through immobility. It remains anchored in ث ب ت B001's durable continuity and in packet-local images of motion subjected to purpose and maintained without interruption. Downstream prose should call it an invariant or governance analogy, not claim that ثبات literally means movement.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The persistence aspect of ث ب ت across the two life-horizons, set beside divine فعل and مشيئة.

activation_trace.role: Continuance against cessation supplies stability as persistence through time rather than mere spatial arrest.
Subduing and driving a thing toward a purpose supplies governed motion in ships and rivers.
Flowing and continuous movement supply a system that remains ordered while changing position.
Persistent, unremitting exertion supplies continuity maintained by repeated activity.

changed_reading.before: A fixed saying and stabilized believer are motionless or insulated from change.
changed_reading.after: Their stability may be invariant order through sustained motion: a reliable course maintained across changing conditions by purposeful divine action.

strongest_changes: The adjacent word-tree sequence revised static firmness into rooted, recurring productivity opposed by uprooting and absent settlement.
The truthful-promise/failed-promise contrast made the fixed saying a reliable speech-act whose fulfillment survives temporal deferral.
The earlier near-life/later-life path sequence made stability a maintained orientation across competing horizons.
Ash dispersal, habitation under displacement, hidden/public integrity, and final accounting exposed distinct material, social, personal, and forensic mechanisms without forcing them into one reading.
summary.what_was_special: The packet repeatedly made stability dynamic rather than inert: roots bear yield, promises arrive in reality, coherent material resists dispersal, communities remain through displacement, and ordered systems persist through motion. The split ق و ل -> ق ل ل inventory and the locust branch preserved two form-distant but visibly anchored pressures that a conservative synthesis would likely erase.
remaining_uncertainties: The causal force assigned to بِٱلْقَوْلِ remains open: instrument, accompaniment, and sphere of stabilization are all live.
The tree sequence is adjacent and lexically continuous, but transferring every plant relation to believers remains a reader inference.
The forensic, habitation, and hidden/public models are coherent whole-surah activations, yet none excludes the simpler inward-firmness baseline.
The split-root oscillation, oviposition, and ordered-motion outliers should remain qualified analogies rather than lexical glosses.
